Architect scalable solutions, apply advanced software design patterns, and mentor junior and medior developers. Project description

In this role, you lead complex multidisciplinary industrial engineering projects within the process industry. You are fully accountable for scope, budget, planning, quality and safety across both new installations and major modifications to existing assets.

Primary Tasks & Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end ownership of industrial engineering projects from concept and feasibility through commissioning and final handover.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget (including business case and investment approval) and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate all project phases: pre-study and concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement and contractor selection, construction and site execution, commissioning, and handover to operations.
• Act as the single point of accountability for internal stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS disciplines, working with both internal and external parties.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims, and deviations affecting budget or schedule.
• Report progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a Project Manager with proven A-Z ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• Minimum 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• Demonstrated experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting and investment approval, and commissioning of industrial installations.
• Mandatory experience in the process industry.
• Strong hands-on command of MS Project, with ownership of planning rather than follow-up only.
• Academic working level combined with strong analytical skills and a helicopter view.
Non-Technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and take full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You bring strong leadership skills and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when needed.
• You communicate effectively with stakeholders at every organisational level.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / Certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Responsibilities

• Design and build Layer 3 data models and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines in a cloud environment.
• Integrate disparate data sources including demand, supply, and financial actuals into unified datasets.
• Develop and maintain advanced transformation flows to support migrations from legacy systems to modern architectures.
• Translate ambiguous business requirements into structured data solutions and actionable insights.
• Enable scalable reporting by building robust data models and dashboards for executive decision-making.
• Identify pragmatic AI use cases for forecasting improvements and trend detection.

Requirements

• 8+ years of data engineering experience focusing on Snowflake and expert-level SQL.
• 8+ years of experience in business intelligence using Tableau (Desktop and Prep) and Power BI.
• Extensive experience designing ETL/ELT frameworks and data transformation pipelines.
• In-depth functional knowledge of portfolio planning, resource forecasting, and financial planning.
• Proven expertise in data modeling and performance optimization for large-scale transformations.
• Strong experience integrating cross-domain enterprise data from systems like SAP HANA.
• You possess strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills to resolve cross-system data inconsistencies.
• You bring exceptional technical communication skills to engage with both IT and business stakeholders.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Planisware for portfolio and project data management.
• Knowledge of practical AI/ML applications and building flows with Copilot.
• Active knowledge of Dutch.

Responsibilities

• Translate business needs into clear, data-driven requirements and generate actionable insights for decision-making.
• Design and build interactive dashboards in Power BI and deliver ad-hoc analyses and recommendations.
• Coordinate project planning, testing, and deployment while managing risks and maintaining project documentation.
• Facilitate workshops and act as the primary liaison between business units and technical IT teams.
• Support the integration of AI and Generative AI solutions through change management and adoption initiatives.
• Create high-quality PowerPoint narratives to communicate visuals, ROI, and influence executive decision-making.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst within data-focused projects.
• You bring 3+ years of experience working in structured project environments including planning and coordination.
• You possess strong technical proficiency in SQL and Power BI for data reporting.
• You're an expert in Excel and executive-level PowerPoint storytelling.
• You have professional functional experience within the insurance sector.
• You bring strong analytical skills and experience collaborating in cross-functional teams.
• You possess excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• You are fluent in English, Dutch, and French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud environments.
• Knowledge of Databricks platforms.

As Project Manager, you take end-to-end responsibility for complex multidisciplinary investment projects within an industrial process setting. Our partner is aninternational and well-established organisationwith operations across several European locations. Its IT environment supports a diverse international workforce and relies on a collaborative team of engineers to keep everything running smoothly.

EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground.
 

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

 

What will you do?

• You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
• You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
• Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
• You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
• You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
• You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
• You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.

Who are you? 

• You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
• You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
• You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
• You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
• You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
• You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
• You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.
You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant: A Dynamic and Evolving Sector
jobs.description:
About the company

Our client is a well-established player in the logistics and transportation sector, operating across multiple sites and international flows. In a context of strong operational activity, the company is looking to strengthen its accounting team to support its growth and the increasing complexity of its operations.

The company offers a dynamic working environment where responsiveness and accuracy are essential to managing significant and diverse financial flows.

Your role

As a Senior Accountant, you will join an accounting team and play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the accounts within a high-volume, multi-site environment.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Managing general accounting and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the accounts across several entities or sites.
• Participating in monthly and annual closings in a context of high and diverse business volumes.
• Monitoring and analysing operational costs (transportation, fuel, subcontracting) and identifying opportunities for optimisation.
• Performing bank and accounting reconciliations, ensuring the consistency of multi-site financial flows.
• Collaborating with operational teams to ensure reliable and accurate financial information.
• Contributing to the improvement of accounting processes in an industry where speed of execution is key.

Your profile

• You have at least 8 years of solid experience in general accounting, ideally in a high-volume operational environment.
• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
• You are fluent in French, English and Dutch, both spoken and written.
• You are detail-oriented and able to maintain an overview while managing a high volume of transactions.
• You are responsive and comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly.
• You enjoy working as part of a team and are comfortable collaborating with operational stakeholders on a daily basis.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Officer – Technical Sales Support & Logistics
jobs.description:
Navision, order processing and follow-up form the core of the role – but the position is clearly broader than traditional order administration. 

As Administrative Officer – Technical Sales Support & Logistics, you are a key link between customers, suppliers and your colleagues. As you gain experience, you can also become more involved in logistics follow-up and the administrative support of technical projects.
  
• Process and follow up customer orders in Microsoft Dynamics Navision. 
• Prepare quotations, order confirmations and purchase orders. 
• Place orders with suppliers and actively follow up delivery dates. 
• Support customers with questions about parts, spare parts and service. 
• Request prices and quotations from suppliers. 
• Follow up transport, deliveries, incoming goods and stock information. 
• Work closely with sales, project managers, engineers and technicians. 
• Occasionally provide practical support with a delivery or in the warehouse.  
The practical logistics component is limited – around 5 to 10% of the role – but it reflects the way Buhlmann works: colleagues do not constantly draw a line around where one job description ends and another begins.
 
Once you know the organisation well, your responsibilities can expand towards project support, for example project files in SharePoint, material orders, delivery follow-up and administrative preparation for invoicing.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is administratively strong, takes responsibility and shows initiative. 

You preferably have relevant experience in order administration, purchasing, sales support, customer service, logistics administration or a technical sales support role. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but an interest in a technical environment is important.
  
• Experience with an ERP system; knowledge of Navision is a strong advantage. SAP or a comparable system also provides a good basis. 
• You work accurately and in a structured way and can keep several files, deliveries and deadlines under control at the same time. 
• You take initiative: if a supplier needs to be chased or a file needs further investigation, you do not simply wait. 
• You are collegial and practically minded and do not mind occasionally helping with a delivery. 
• You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate professionally in English. French is a clear advantage; German is a welcome extra.

You will spend around 90% of your time in the field. Working with a colleague, you will carry out maintenance, inspections and technical interventions on specialised installations in the rail environment. Most assignments are in Antwerp, Brussels and Ghent, with additional interventions elsewhere. 
 
• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on technical installations. 
• Analyse and resolve mechanical, electromechanical and electrical faults. 
• Assess technical situations independently and help determine the appropriate course of action. 
• Carry out measurements, inspections and interventions using professional tools and test equipment. 
• Liaise with colleagues, engineers and project managers. 
• Depending on your experience, coordinate activities and take a leading role in the field.  
Rail experience is an advantage, but not essential. You bring a solid technical background and relevant practical experience; Buhlmann will teach you the specific installations, procedures and safety requirements of the rail environment. Experience in industrial maintenance, machine building, installation engineering or field service can be highly relevant.
 
After your induction period, you will take part in the on-call rota. Urgent night-time interventions are limited to a few occasions per year. In addition, there is on average around one planned night intervention per month, with time off in lieu afterwards.

We are looking for an experienced technician who knows the trade, can tackle technical problems independently and takes responsibility for safe, high-quality execution. 
 
• Technical qualification in electromechanics, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent experience. 
• Several years of relevant practical experience in maintenance, industrial installations, machine building, field service or a comparable technical environment. 
• Strong foundation in mechanics and electromechanics, complemented by sufficient electrical knowledge. 
• You analyse problems methodically, work independently and consult others when the situation requires it. 
• You enjoy field work and are comfortable in a role involving travel to different sites. 
• Experience as a lead technician, team leader or site supervisor is an advantage; even in such a role, you still want to remain technically involved. 
• You can communicate operationally in Dutch and/or French and have sufficient English for technical communication.
